Chapter 6092: Bizarre

Chapter 6092: Bizarre

“So this is Heavenly Wrath?” Someone said while looking at a strange dragon coming out of the well.

First-timers knew about the legendary weapon crafted by the temple lord but didn’t know of its form.

The dragon was covered in unknown metallic scales. They were gestated by the lightning currents and became priceless materials - the goals of the visitors.

They only wanted the scales and didn’t harbor any thought about the dragon itself. None could tame it because touching it meant invoking a heavenly tribulation. It would follow an emperor or desolate god until death.

“So that’s the case.” Li Qiye understood why this dragon has its current form.

“Raa!” The dragon soared outward, wanting to escape the plain and the temple.

“What is it doing?!” Many big shots shouted in astonishment since this was their first time here.

“Crackle!” However, lightning bolts were absorbed by the peaks and channeled back into the earth veins. They transformed into numerous divine chains wrapping around the dragon and pulling it back.

The peaks shook violently and the unaware were pushed off. This made them susceptible to the lightning bolts, resulting in screams and death.

Spectators wisened up and did everything they could to stay on the peaks.

“Bam!” The plain seemed to be dragged upward, on the verge of being flipped over.

Alas, the dragon couldn’t escape. The lightning bolts emanating from its body were the most potent weapons but in this case, they served as chains preventing it from escape.

“So Heavenly Wrath is trapped here.” Newcomers understood the situation.

“Taming it alone isn’t enough, we can’t even take it out.” One ancestor said.

“Now!” A big shot made his move, summoning a bow and shooting the dragon.

“Whoosh!” The arrow struck and knocked down a scale.

“One piece!” Many shouted in excitement after seeing a falling material.

He didn’t have time to grab the scale before the dragon turned around and spewed out lightning bolts.

The peak beneath attempted to absorb lightning bolts but it couldn’t do so fast enough.

“Ahh!” The remnant bolts reduced him to ashes before being channeled back to the earth veins and the well.

“Whoosh!” The falling scale soared like a meteor before smashing into the area next to Li Qiye.

Everyone got a good look at it - a dragon scale around the size of a bowl. It emitted a gentle glow of the heavenly affinity.

“Like a blind cat coming across a dead mouse.” Many became jealous of his luck.

Li Qiye only smiled and didn’t bother picking it up.

“Break!” Golden Flower made her move and knocked down a scale.

Alas, a tail whip pulverized her hand before she could grab it. The dragon also sent another wave of lightning bolts at her.

“Damn!” She transformed into a solar flower and created a massive fiery barrier.

“Rumble!” This bought just enough time for the peak to absorb the lightning bolts.

“Whoosh!” The scale she took down also soared across the air and landed next to Li Qiye.

“How bizarre!” Many shouted after seeing a second scale crashing near Li Qiye.

This material was precious enough for emperors and desolate gods to risk their lives. Now, Li Qiye could pick up two without any effort.

While Golden Flower withstood the brunt of the attack, Witch King, Dragonform, Ouyang Dragon God, and Dragon Pond took action.

“Break!” Witch King released a nether beam.

“Go!” Dragonform thrust his spear forward.

“Now!” The others joined in as well.

“Rumble!” They struck the dragon and successfully knocked down a scale each. The next step was to survive the waterfall-like bolts coming from the dragon’s mouth.
